title: Editrace template
description: A reverse-engineered video edit: cuts, pacing, motion, transitions, text, captions, beats and color, with slots in place of media. All times are integer frames on the single timebase source.fps (ADR 0002). The template never contains source media or audio.

schema_version.description: Semver of the template schema this document was written against. Minor versions are additive only; consumers reject a major version they do not know (ADR 0002).

tracks.description: Ordered tracks. Each track holds one kind of element; track order is bottom to top.

Id.description: Stable identifier, unique within the document. Lowercase letters, digits, hyphen and underscore.

Frames.description: A count of frames on the template timebase (source.fps). Never seconds.

Rational.description: An exact ratio num/den, used for fps, speed and aspect ratio so no float drift enters the file. 29.97 fps is 30000/1001.

FrameRange.description: A span of frames: start is the first frame, duration the number of frames it covers.

duration.description: Length of the span in frames (at least 1).

Confidence.description: How sure the detector is, 0 to 1. Hand-authored elements use 1.

Provenance.description: Which detector produced an element, so results can be traced and re-run. Hand-authored elements use the detector name "manual".

version.description: Detector version that produced the element.

Detection.description: Mixed into every detected element: how confident we are and where it came from.

NormalizedBBox.description: A box in normalized frame coordinates: x and y are the top-left corner, w and h the size, all as fractions (0 to 1) of frame width and height. x + w and y + h must not exceed 1; this is checked by consumers, not by the schema.

Source.description: The reference video this template was derived from, described but never embedded.

duration.description: Length of the reference video in frames at fps.

fps.description: The template timebase: every frame count in the document is on this rate. Constant, because variable-frame-rate references are conformed at ingest.

vfr.description: True if the reference had a variable frame rate and was conformed to fps at ingest. Defaults to false.

original_fps.description: Nominal frame rate of the reference before conforming. Provenance only; set when vfr is true.

resolution.description: Pixel size of the reference video.

aspect_ratio.description: Display aspect ratio, e.g. 9/16 for vertical video.

content_hash.description: Hash of the reference file, used to cache and de-duplicate analysis.

Track.description: A layer of one kind of element. Unknown kinds are accepted so newer minor versions stay readable; consumers skip them.

slots.description: Video tracks only: placeholders for the user's own footage.

cuts.description: Video tracks only: hard cuts between slots.

transitions.description: Video tracks only: transitions between slots.

Slot.description: A placeholder for one shot of the user's own footage. Holds timing and treatment only, never media.

range.description: Where the slot sits on the output timeline.

source_range.description: Where this shot sits in the reference video, if different from range (e.g. the reference was trimmed or reordered).

speed.description: Playback speed as an exact ratio; 1/1 is normal, 2/1 is double speed. Defaults to 1/1.

zoom_pan.description: Zoom and pan keyframes in time order. Frames are offsets from the start of the slot.

ZoomPanKeyframe.description: The framing at one moment inside a slot; values between keyframes follow the easing of the earlier one.

frame.description: Offset in frames from the start of the slot.

scale.description: Zoom factor; 1 is the full frame, 2 is a 2x punch-in.

center.description: Point of the frame that sits at the center of the view, in normalized coordinates.

easing.description: How to move to the next keyframe. Defaults to linear.

Color.description: Per-shot color treatment as relative adjustments. All fields are optional; omitted means unchanged.

lut.description: Name of a look-up table to apply. A name only; the table itself is never embedded.

Cut.description: A hard cut on the output timeline.

frame.description: The first frame of the shot after the cut.

type.description: Kind of transition. "other" with type_detail covers anything not listed.

range.description: Frames the transition covers on the output timeline.
Frames during which the text is visible.

TextStyle.description: Hints for reproducing the look of text. Editors approximate these.

font_size.description: Cap height as a fraction of frame height.

background_color.description: Box behind the text as #RRGGBB, if any.

Caption.description: A caption block made of lines of timed words.

range.description: Frames the whole block is on screen.

lines.description: Lines in display order; each line is one row of words on screen.

range.description: Frames during which the word is spoken or highlighted.

Beats.description: Beat grid of the reference soundtrack. Markers only; no audio.

beat_frames.description: Frame of every beat, in ascending order. Includes the downbeats.

downbeat_frames.description: Frame of every downbeat (first beat of a bar), in ascending order.

SoundRef.description: A pointer to the sound used in the reference video. Identification only: audio is never stored or exported. This object is closed so audio fields cannot be added.

id.description: Identifier of the sound at the provider that identified it.

link.description: https link to the sound at its source.
